comment: CANT-360. Client-side attach wording that the web and the Flutter client both show and must keep identical (CANT-357 ruling 5). The web test (web/attach.test.ts) asserts ONE_IMAGE_MESSAGE in web/src/attach.ts equals oneImage; the Dart test (app/test/attach_test.dart) asserts oneImageMessage in app/lib/store/attach.dart equals it.
